source.label: FY2026 Form 20-F, Item 6.D Employees
source.quote: As of March 31, 2024, 2025 and 2026, we had a total of 204,891, 124,320 and 131,462 full‑time employees, respectively.

notes: Employees: full-time employees at the March 31, 2026 fiscal year end, from the FY2026 20-F. Payroll is null: the 20-F gives no total of salaries, staff costs or employee benefits (staff costs appear only as components of cost of revenue and operating expense lines; the only aggregate is directors' and executive officers' pay of about RMB250 million), and Alibaba, a foreign private issuer, files no proxy and has no CEO pay ratio. This year's 20-F attaches no Hong Kong annual report exhibit.
